recent_updates.event: Phase 2b LUNA trial ongoing. 2-year study actively enrolling 81 participants (ages 8+). Trial sites in US, UK, and Netherlands. Latest update on ClinicalTrials.gov: October 2, 2025
First patient dosed in Phase 2b LUNA trial

notes: Targets Usher syndrome type 2A and RP with USH2A mutations. 2-year trial with 81 participants ages 8 and up.
